rows.claim: All525 canonical IDs/scopes and existing owner/status/evidence gaps remain visible; terminal worksheet provenance enforced at release.
rows.remaining: Real accountable implementation/test owners and evidence reconciliation remain absent.
rows.requirement: Every requirement in all source tabs must have a stable checklist ID, scope classification, implementation owner, test owner, status, and evidence reference; nothing may be silently omitted.

rows.claim: Accepted labels, unreviewed/failed criterion strings and scope-only functional PASS cannot bypass the four-criterion release record.
rows.remaining: Structural record validity is not actual functional or device/integration proof.
rows.requirement: A feature is not complete merely because code, a class, a route, a UI card, or a test stub exists; acceptance requires functional and device/integration evidence appropriate to the feature.

rows.claim: Each terminal criterion cites in-row hashed proof; independent review label pins exact tested source; stale source refuses before network.
rows.remaining: File hashes and labels do not establish reproducibility, genuine identity, evidence truth or the appropriate live/device artifact.
rows.requirement: Every PASS must cite concrete evidence: source/commit, test ID/result, and the relevant device/backend/UI artifact. Evidence must be reproducible and tied to the reviewed release identity.

rows.claim: Exact canonical525 rows preserved; read-only report includes every ID and identifies missing worksheet dimensions.
rows.remaining: Prior proof still needs per-ID reconciliation; merely mapping an ID is not its acceptance.
rows.requirement: If any source requirement cannot be mapped to a checklist ID and evidence path, the final audit fails even if all mapped items pass.

rows.claim: Report preserves current statuses/dispositions rather than manufacturing accepted, unsupported or deferred results.
rows.remaining: Every actual final disposition/owner/independent review remains pending.
rows.requirement: Each phase closure must identify ACCEPTED items, OPEN BLOCKERS, and VERIFIED UNSUPPORTED items; nothing may disappear between phase reports.

rows.claim: Report retains all C1-C4 values, proof references, severity, blocker reason and remediation for each canonical ID; missing IDs/classes cannot silently pass.
rows.remaining: 2100 unreviewed worksheet slots are not2100 runnable tests; meanings, applicability and final results require review.
rows.requirement: AI audit output must list every checklist ID, C1-C4 result, evidence, severity, blocker reason, and remediation; missing IDs are an automatic audit failure.
